requirement_alignment: Every visible title, axis, legend, month and footnote is English; internal assumptions are identified.
data_expression_quality: Exact monthly sums or unsmoothed interval commitments; units are explicit. Totals name each policy.
style_preservation: Matplotlib serif line-bar grammar, muted fills and the selected template palette are retained.
readability: Actual repaired PNG inspected by the assistant with view_image; labels and series are legible.
layout_quality: Dedicated legend band clears the first row; no visible overlaps or clipped labels.
color_quality: Gray baseline, blue/orange comparison or cyan state with rust emergency bars are distinguishable.
